summary: The recall of AvKare Carboxymethylcellulose Sodium Ophthalmic Solution 0.5% (lots 3161, 3245, 3260, 3298‑3300, 3301‑3302, 3305‑3306) has been reported only by U.S. sources (FDA, Prevention.com, Ophthalmology Advisor, etc.). No reports from other national regulators, WHO, or regional agencies were found.
